subject.title: perf: bound publisher profile, membership, and catalog reads

question: Should GitHub-backed publisher display manifests preserve complete-catalog output, or may they use a bounded/paginated manifest contract?
rationale: The merged work deliberately left this path open because the right completeness, consumer, and compatibility contract was not established by the profile/catalog optimization.

options.title: Define a bounded manifest contract
options.body: Specify the minimum manifest data and pagination/limit behavior, then implement it with visibility and table-read-bound tests.

options.title: Preserve complete manifests intentionally
options.body: Document the full-catalog requirement and its expected workload boundary, leaving this query outside the bounded profile path.

options.title: Track a dedicated manifest follow-up
options.body: Move the remaining contract decision to a focused issue if it cannot be resolved within this performance item.

recommendation.title: Define a bounded manifest contract
recommendation.body: Specify the minimum manifest data and pagination/limit behavior, then implement it with visibility and table-read-bound tests.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the audit, partial implementation, and explicit statement of the unresolved contract.
